FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF VICE CHAIRMAN OF THE KARANDENIYAPRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66B(2) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION (AMENDMENT)ACT, No. 16 OF 2017
WHEREAS the office of a Vice Chairman in Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized political party to whichRanjith Donald Ranaweera the former Vice Chairman belonged, was required by me under section 66B(2) of the aforesaidordinance, to decide upon the member of that Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall bedeclared elected as Vice Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Subasinghe Pathiranage Nimal Bandu to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Malawenna Godage Lalith Ananda, Returning Officer of Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66B(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) as amended by LocalAuthorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 16 of 2017 do hereby declare Subasinghe Pathiranage Nimal Bandu electedas Vice Chairman of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha.
M. G. LALITH ANANDA,Returning Officer,Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha.
